quotes.text: He’s got another MRI this afternoon because he had quite a lot of fluid in the area… Let’s be a little bit patient so we can give a definitive assessment.
Still being some players clearly out like [Amadou] Onana, Aaron Wan-Bissaka and [Matteo] Ruggeri.
Junior [Eli Junior Kroupi] is back into the team training, but not on the UEFA list. But maybe we can have him for some minutes in Manchester… Now we’re going to miss him [Alex Toth] for some weeks.
Jannik [Schuster] just had a bit of a troubled week going into the Liverpool game… But he’s been back training the last few days, so he’s back to himself, more or less.
They won’t be available for tomorrow… With Femi [Azeez], again we have to be patient with him. It’s not quite clear how long it will take.
He’s [Emiliano Martinez] doing better. He had the surgery… A few weeks. Hopefully less than more, but we need to wait.
The ankle’s a bit of a problem, so it’s affecting his [Josh Eccles] rehab and his recovery.
Ben Chilwell is back. Tomiyasu is out until the next international break… Dean [Henderson] started to train with the team…
Christian [Nørgaard] was the first one to come to me to say he was sorry about it and he’s realised he’s probably a bit further away than we probably all thought.
No, he’s not going to make it. Sasa [Lukic] will be out tomorrow.
Our offensive players from the last game are all doubtful… Dominic Calvert-Lewin got a tackle… Anton Stach, the same… Noah Okafor is struggling…
Dom [Dominik Szoboszlai] is going to be out this weekend… Bradley [Barcola] has trained today normally.
For sure, Erling [Haaland] is the only one 100% available, and the other three we need to wait for today’s session.
He’s [Morgan Gibbs-White] ready. He trained the entire week and so, no issues.
Brian [Brobbey] is in a good place… He won’t play tomorrow, that’s obvious, but he should be ready for Leeds.
